bibliography: Paller, V. G. V., Corpuz, M. N. C., & Ocampo, P. P. (2013). Diversity and distribution of freshwater fish assemblages in Tayabas River, Quezon (Philippines). Philippine Journal of Science, 142(1), 55-67.

accessReview.publisherPdf: Readable through the official publisher PDF text viewer; 1,144 extracted lines were available for review.

survey.vouchers: The paper says some vouchers were deposited at the UPLB Museum of Natural History; catalog numbers were not located in the reviewed text.

historicalAggregate.interpretation: Published study aggregate from the 2010 survey only; not a current abundance estimate, complete present-day inventory, or species-level app record.

localityLimits.paperDescription: The article describes an approximately 8.5-9 km river traversing Tayabas and Lucena before draining to Tayabas Bay.
localityLimits.stationCoordinates: Not transferred. A general river coordinate and a figure with numbered sites do not establish a station coordinate list or validated river geometry.
localityLimits.municipalReachCrosswalk: The paper's general city description does not assign each station to a municipality or provide station-level locality text.

seasonLabelConflict.methods: The paper says three-day sampling in February and September 2010 represented wet and dry seasons, respectively.
seasonLabelConflict.studySiteClimateDescription: The same paper describes the study site as relatively dry from November to April and wet during the rest of the year.
seasonLabelConflict.decision: These statements conflict for the February assignment. Retain the reported months and the contradiction; do not assign season-specific results to calendar months.

rightsReview.journalAccessStatement: PJS describes its online journal as open access.
rightsReview.authorsGuideStatement: The current author guide says authors are asked to sign a Copyright Transfer form when a manuscript is accepted.
rightsReview.decision: Journal-level open access and the current author-guide statement do not establish the exact rights or license applicable to this 2013 article. Do not transcribe or republish its species table without item-specific rights clarification.

nextActions: Seek item-specific permission or a separately licensed source that supports the same fish evidence before considering table transcription or publication.
If a rights-cleared path becomes available, verify taxonomic names and station-to-reach/municipality assignments independently before creating any species assertions.
Keep the 2010 aggregate historical and the season-to-month mapping unresolved; do not construct station geometry from the figure or general river coordinate.
Continue screening other CALABARZON inland, brackish and coastal waterbodies in parallel.
